meta.name: deep-research
meta.description: This skill should be used when conducting comprehensive research on any topic using the OpenAI Deep Research API. It automates prompt enhancement through interactive clarifying questions, saves research parameters, and executes deep research with web search capabilities. Use when the user asks for in-depth analysis, investigation, research summaries, or topic exploration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动进行深度研究并生成分析报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速获取某个主题的深度研究结果
copy.tagline_en: Automate deep research and generate analysis reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick, in-depth research on any topic

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会通过 OpenAI Deep Research API 对任何主题进行深度研究。它会先判断你的提问是否太简短，如果是，就主动追问几个问题来帮你把研究范围、深度和关注点说清楚，然后自动执行联网搜索，最后生成一份带来源链接的详细研究报告。
howto.when: 当你要求对某个主题进行深入分析、调查、研究总结或探索时触发。例如你说“研究一下……”“分析……”“调查……的最新进展”。

say.text: 研究一下2025年AI在医疗领域的最新应用。
say.note: Claude会先判断是否需追问，然后执行深度研究并返回报告。

say.text: 帮我分析分布式数据库系统的优缺点对比。
say.note: Claude会细化研究参数，生成带来源的对比报告。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses the OpenAI Deep Research API to conduct in-depth research on any topic. It assesses if your query is too brief; if so, it asks clarifying questions to refine scope, depth, and focus, then performs web-enabled research and returns a detailed report with sources.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for in-depth analysis, investigation, research summaries, or topic exploration. For example, saying "Research...", "Analyze...", or "Investigate the latest developments in...".

say_en.text: Research the latest AI applications in healthcare for 2025.
Analyze the pros and cons of distributed database systems.
say_en.note: Claude will refine parameters and generate a comparative report with sources.
